title: edit
description: Verified structural editing — replaces sed, awk and patch (SDD 9.4). Symbol verbs (replace_body | insert_after | insert_before | rename) address code via the Tier-1 index; rewrite applies an ast-grep pattern across a glob scope; replace_text is the anchored literal fallback for any file. Every verb resolves to a full-content write batch through the 7.5 write engine: dry-run diff, parse-verify (a new syntax error rejects the whole call with PARSE_REJECTED), format, journal, atomic swap. Under edit.confirm_mode = "token", all verified writes apply on the first call unless edit.force_confirm is set. Dry runs never apply and presented confirmations are always validated. In human confirmation mode, single-file symbol/text edits auto-apply; rewrite, rename, and any op touching more than one file or more than 200 changed lines are confirm-gated (SDD 9.4): on MRTR clients the confirmation is elicited inside the same call, otherwise CONFIRM_REQUIRED carries the aggregated dry-run diff plus an HMAC-sealed confirmToken — re-invoke the identical call with confirm set to that token to apply. A stale confirm fails closed with STALE_ANCHOR, a forged or mismatched one with CONFIRM_MISMATCH. read's contentHash is the staleness anchor: pass it as expectedHash and a changed file answers STALE_ANCHOR with the fresh hash.

op.description: replace_body: replace the addressed symbol's whole definition with `content`. insert_after / insert_before: insert `content` after/before the symbol's extent. rename: rename the symbol to `newName` across the definition file and every index-known reference file (word-boundary, name-resolution-free). rewrite: apply `pattern` -> `rewritePattern` (ast-grep, $VAR metavariables) across `path`. replace_text: replace `old` with `new` in `file` (literal; `occurrence` picks one match, absent replaces all).

file.description: Workspace-relative target file. Required for symbol verbs and replace_text.

symbol.description: Symbol address within `file`, e.g. UserService.authenticate or Rust's Config::load — same dialect as read, both separators. Requires the Tier-1 index (INDEX_UNAVAILABLE until warm); ambiguity answers AMBIGUOUS_SYMBOL with candidates naming the type (and trait, for a Rust trait impl).

content.description: The replacement or inserted source text (replace_body, insert_after, insert_before).

pattern.description: rewrite only: the ast-grep match pattern ($VAR metavariables). Structural on the native core; degraded lanes apply it literally and say so.

rewritePattern.description: rewrite only: the replacement pattern ($VAR metavariables carry over).

path.description: rewrite only: glob scope over workspace-relative paths, e.g. src/**. Defaults to the whole workspace (vendor/junk excluded).

lang.description: rewrite only: restrict to one language by extension family, e.g. ts, python, rust. An unknown value is treated as a literal file extension.

old.description: replace_text only: the exact literal text to replace. An empty old populates an existing zero-byte file; a nonempty file answers STALE_ANCHOR and a missing file answers FILE_NOT_FOUND. Not found (or occurrence out of range) answers STALE_ANCHOR with the fresh contentHash — re-read and re-anchor.

new.description: replace_text only: the replacement text (empty string deletes the match).

occurrence.description: replace_text only: 1-based match to replace. Absent replaces every occurrence.

expectedHash.description: read's contentHash for `file`. A mismatch with the file's current content answers STALE_ANCHOR carrying the fresh hash (SDD 9.3/7.7).

dryRun.description: Run the full pipeline through re-verify and return the diffs, touching nothing.

confirm.description: The confirmToken from a prior CONFIRM_REQUIRED answer for this exact call (SDD 9.4). Verified statelessly against the per-workspace key: valid and current applies; files moved under the confirmed diff answers STALE_ANCHOR; a forged token or changed arguments answers CONFIRM_MISMATCH.

autoApply.description: Apply an already-authorized operation without an additional confirmation round trip. All path, syntax, staleness and journal checks remain active; dryRun still never applies. Token mode already applies without this flag unless force_confirm is set.
